qualification: Documented fictional teaching judgments. This journal replays only exact binding hashes; a changed declaration needs a new deliberate meaning, scope and units review. No person is authenticated and no real commitment is approved.

bindings.meaning: Compare the supplied incremental growth commitments for funding and delivery feasibility. Optional learning compares a complete test-and-response policy under explicit hypothetical probabilities; feasibility alone selects no winner.
bindings.scope: One standard service package, four complete arrangements, one recorded planning origin and the full declared obligation horizon. No customer demand, bank receipt or spending authorization is established.
bindings.units: USD cents for money, whole elapsed days from the case origin, whole customers and delivery hours; no implicit currency or time conversion.

bindings.meaning: Pin the exact Complete a Commitment app that separates economic expense from ordered receipts and payments and checks delivery capacity in its declared period.
bindings.scope: Only the published four alternatives and mandatory cash, capacity, timing, payment-term and baseline conditions. A changed app pin requires renewed binding review.
bindings.units: Native monetary inputs and results are integer USD cents; dates are whole elapsed days; workload and capacity are hours, not elapsed availability.

bindings.meaning: Pin the exact value-of-learning app requiring a complete operating eligibility record for every action, state and before/after-test context.
bindings.scope: One nonbinding preference test, two declared payment-response situations and favorable, unfavorable or inconclusive signals. It takes no deposits and cannot waive a failed operating condition.
bindings.units: Expected monetary contribution and test fees use USD cents; priors and likelihoods are dimensionless probabilities; test delay is whole elapsed days.

bindings.meaning: Use already unrestricted incremental growth funds as the opening cash ledger balance. Existing obligations have been accounted for once and are not deducted again.
bindings.scope: Funds actually available to this complete commitment at the planning origin, distinct from total bank balance or forecast receipts.
bindings.units: Nonnegative integer USD cents. Forms and Excel may show USD with an explicit divisor of 100.

bindings.meaning: Maintain this additional minimum balance after each explicitly ordered cash event, including intermediate same-day payments.
bindings.scope: The same reserve applies to all supplied arrangements and situations; opening funds below the reserve already fail the cash condition.
bindings.units: Nonnegative integer USD cents, compared with ledger balances before and after every event.

bindings.meaning: Multiply each situation-specific customer count by the complete collected price per standardized package. Collection timing is supplied separately.
bindings.scope: One full-payment package and currency. Installments, tax, default, refunds and earned-revenue recognition need a revised authored model.
bindings.units: Nonnegative integer USD cents per customer. Customer counts are whole numbers.

bindings.meaning: Multiply forecast customers by complete incremental delivery expense per customer. Do not include committed campaign expense a second time.
bindings.scope: The full variable expense of the one authored package; no expense is inferred from a marketing acquisition ratio.
bindings.units: Nonnegative integer USD cents per customer. Multiplication must stay inside safe integer bounds.

bindings.meaning: Multiply each forecast customer count by the complete delivery hours for one standardized package.
bindings.scope: All workload is assigned to the explicitly referenced capacity period. Hours in another period cannot repair that period shortage.
bindings.units: Positive whole hours per customer; this is effort rather than the elapsed length of the delivery interval.

bindings.meaning: Record when the new decision can be made. A nonzero promised event in the past cannot be used as a future commitment.
bindings.scope: One common planning origin for all alternatives and test contexts. Historical committed payments would require a different continuing-commitment basis.
bindings.units: Nonnegative whole elapsed days from the declared origin, not local date strings.

bindings.meaning: Keep an expansion action available only through its recorded commitment cutoff. Preserve the no-expansion baseline after the cutoff.
bindings.scope: The growth commitment window, distinct from delivery completion and the full comparison horizon.
bindings.units: Nonnegative whole elapsed days from the same origin as currentDay; equality at the cutoff is permitted.

bindings.meaning: Include every declared payment, receipt and complete delivery obligation in the comparison. An omitted later receipt cannot manufacture an affordable first month.
bindings.scope: The full bounded contract horizon for every alternative and situation; a longer obligation requires extending this horizon and supplying all relevant consequences.
bindings.units: Positive whole elapsed days from the common origin; event and delivery dates must not exceed it.

bindings.meaning: Calculate the whole-customer hurdle for recovering campaign expense plus this stated contribution target. It does not constrain operational feasibility or predict customer response.
bindings.scope: An incremental target above the complete committed campaign expense, separate from the mandatory cash reserve.
bindings.units: Nonnegative integer USD cents. Hurdles use explicit ceiling division only when contribution per customer is positive.

bindings.meaning: Supply a complete fixed campaign quote for each authored alternative. That expense remains committed when realized customers fall to zero.
bindings.scope: Exactly the current-approach, large invoice, small invoice and medium prepayment alternatives. The current-approach quote remains zero.
bindings.units: Integer USD cents for each complete campaign, independent of customer counts and collection dates.

bindings.meaning: Name the finite joint demand and collection situations to withstand. Each arrangement receives a full outcome in each situation.
bindings.scope: These records are admitted possibilities, not a statistical sample. Neither independent faults nor probabilities are inferred from their count.
bindings.units: Stable string identifiers and readable labels; no implied probability units.

bindings.meaning: Bind each scenario and arrangement to complete customer, cash-date and delivery assumptions and an exact capacity-period identity.
bindings.scope: One row per scenario-arrangement pair; unknown or missing customers are unavailable input rather than zero demand. Payment dates retain the authored invoice or prepayment meanings.
bindings.units: Whole customer counts; nonnegative whole elapsed days for payment, collection and delivery; string references for scenarios, arrangements and capacity periods.

bindings.meaning: Record the incremental hours actually available in each declared delivery period after other work is counted once.
bindings.scope: All work for an outcome fits inside its referenced period. Capacity is not summed across periods and no detailed staffing schedule is inferred.
bindings.units: Whole delivery hours and nonnegative whole elapsed-day endpoints; every period has positive length.

bindings.meaning: Request optional expected-contribution analysis without making it necessary for the ordinary operating comparison.
bindings.scope: The published nonbinding preference test only. The caller must also supply complete named-state and probability assumptions before it can be used.
bindings.units: Boolean request flag; it conveys neither operating authority nor confidence.

bindings.meaning: Supply a complete hypothetical prior and report-likelihood matrix, its provenance, test fee and elapsed delay. Inconclusive results remain explicit.
bindings.scope: Exactly the two authored payment-response states and the three authored signals. Zero probability does not erase logical operating possibilities or excuse failed constraints.
bindings.units: Priors and likelihoods are dimensionless and normalized by the learning contract; fee is integer USD cents and duration is whole elapsed days.

bindings.meaning: Map the same supplied prices, quotes, complete joint outcomes, dates and available capacity into the pinned operating app. Reuse only a complete current native assessment.
bindings.scope: The full four-arrangement comparison under every supplied situation. Project all native blockers, cash findings and workload without independently deciding feasibility.
bindings.units: Carry USD cents, elapsed days, customers and hours without implicit scaling; presentation converts cents to displayed dollars only.

bindings.meaning: Run that same operating app after subtracting the test fee once from available cash and advancing currentDay by the complete test duration.
bindings.scope: Retain the original absolute payment dates, delivery periods and cutoff. The delayed response cannot restart the old decision clock or retain passed commitments.
bindings.units: Subtract fee in USD cents and add duration in elapsed whole days; preserve prices, workload hours and period endpoints.

bindings.meaning: Use native before/after-test findings for complete operating eligibility and native scenario net contribution for payoffs, then evaluate every possible signal and response.
bindings.scope: An action must satisfy its retained operating obligations in every logically admitted situation for that context. Hypothetical expected return cannot compensate for failed cash or capacity.
bindings.units: Risk-neutral expected monetary contribution in USD cents; charge the test fee once; priors and likelihoods remain explicit dimensionless judgments.

bindings.meaning: Assemble current supported commitments, blockers, whole-customer hurdles and optional learning findings. Retain a passing set without fabricating an operating recommendation. When only the no-expansion baseline fits, retain that valid fallback and also expose the next action for resolving the growth arrangements’ blockers.
bindings.scope: A complete current operating comparison supports the decision even when optional learning assumptions are unavailable. Stale or unknown required facts cannot be presented as current results.
bindings.units: Report money as USD converted from cents, workload in hours, dates in elapsed days and hurdle counts as whole customers.

bindings.meaning: Group the same input and report contracts by the decision question. Shared table, cash-chart and learning views use authored labels without domain-specific rendering code.
bindings.scope: Forms are a convenience over the complete canonical YAML. Decision summary, next actions, assumptions and questions retain the same meanings as SDK and CLI output.
bindings.units: Display dollars through an explicit 100-cent scale; retain day, customer and hour labels and expose the exact underlying canonical values.

reviewedChanges: Guard horizon dates by actual positive cash obligations and customer delivery. Zero-value placeholders no longer invent baseline obligations; positive campaign expense remains committed at zero sales.
The learning model and its payoff/eligibility values are unchanged; the 16 source assessment references now identify the corrected native planning runs.
Distinguish no passing expansion from no passing arrangement. Keep the baseline usable while also offering a growth-blocker action and its decision-process path.
Use explicit business labels for summary fields and formatted currency names. No case input, unit conversion, probability or operating payoff changes.
